verdict.rationale: Workable's own API exposes read endpoints for jobs, candidates, offers, events, stages and requisitions. Responses come back as JSON, and the docs claim the API gives "full control over your data," which supports a programmatic, open-format way to pull data out. However, there is no documented bulk or full-account export, data-portability or offboarding feature, so exporting everything means scripting many paginated API calls. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-account export, an explicit list of what data (e.g. resumes, attachments, notes) can be exported, export formats beyond per-endpoint JSON, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete migration out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
